1.
When the case called out in the category of 'mediation failed matters', no one is present to pres this petition.

2. Sri Marjeet Mishra, learned counsel for the informant has filed mention slip along with photocopy of the WhatsApp message sent to learned counsel for the petitioners with an endorsement that the same has been duly received by him and he was even informed on phone as well.
The same is taken on record.

sentences.text: 1 3. Vide order dated 04.1.2024, the matter was referred to the Mediation Centre and as per mediation report dated 05.5.2024, the parties are not willing for mediation.
Therefore, we proceed to consider the case on merits.

4. The present petition has been filed with prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 29.11.2023 registered as Case Crime No.59 of 2023 under Sections 498A, 323, 354-kha, 506 IPC, Section 3/4 of D.P. Act and 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, P.S.
Mahila Thana, District Shamli.

sentences.text: 5. As no one is present to press this petition on behalf of the petitioners, interim order stands vacated.
6. The petition stands dismissed for want of prosecution.
